newsitem.title: USA: Logansport sets special cash distribution.
newsitem.headline: Logansport sets special cash distribution.

text.p: Logansport Financial Corp said Tuesday it authorized a special cash distribution of $3.00 a share.
Logansport, the holding company for Logansport Savings Bank, said the Internal Revenue Service had ruled that most, if not all, of the distribution would qualify as a non-taxable return of capital.

The exact percentage of the distribution to be considered tax-free will be determined at the close of the corporation's 1996 fiscal year. Logansport said shareholders will be advised of that percentage at a later date.
The board said it expected its regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 a share to be tax free, as were previous dividends this year.
The one-time cash distribution will be payable on December 10 to shareholders of record on November 25.

"Our strong capital position resulting from our mutual to stock conversion and our continued good earnings permit us to declare this special distribution that will benefit all of our shareholders," said Thomas Williams, president, in a statement.
